name: A Nutcracker Tale
source:
Based on the classic story of The Nutcracker, you play as the character Clarise, who must help the prince recover the Christmas star, or be faced with a curse. Wander in the world of the Christmas Wonderland Kingdom to help piece together the needed star by the deadline. 

[Edited from [url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/a-nutcracker-tale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
根据《胡桃夹子》的经典故事改编，你扮演的角色克拉丽丝必须帮助王子找回圣诞星，否则就会面临诅咒。漫步在圣诞仙境王国的世界中，帮助在截止日期前拼凑出所需的星星。

[编辑自[url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/a-nutcracker-tale]itch.io[/url]]
